previous_picks.rationale: SAIC leads the universe with +32.97% YTD and a trailing P/E of 15.5, and recently beat Q2 EPS estimates by $0.70. Short interest is elevated at 6.46%, but the strong earnings beat and government IT demand support the momentum.

CACI is up +25% over 1 year and +16.64% YTD with a reasonable P/E of 26, a strong analyst score of 1.56, and positive news sentiment of 0.292. Recent contract wins like the Vantor Space award provide a live catalyst.

Rolls-Royce shows +26% 1-year return, +21.15% YTD, and a strong analyst score of 1.6, supported by civil aerospace recovery and defence engine demand. The P/E of 40 is elevated but justified by earnings growth.

Lockheed Martin was upgraded to Strong-Buy by Wall Street Zen, with an earnings beat of $0.72 EPS and a P/E of 19.7. A potential $24.3B F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia is a live catalyst, though recent -8.91% 1-month slide warrants caution.

AeroVironment has rebounded +9.02% in the past week despite a -37.57% YTD decline. The P/E is undefined due to recent losses, but the stock benefits from drone/space dual narrative and a high short interest of 11.21% could fuel a squeeze.
